claims.text: In the same conversation, asked how Admiral Thomas Wilson reacted when they met, Davis said: 'I can't confirm or deny that we met, for the security reasons.' He said the document 'was released from Mitchell's estate', that Edgar Mitchell had received a copy 'as a courtesy from who generated it', and that it 'was supposed to be destroyed' a year afterwards. Authorship confirmed; the meeting neither confirmed nor denied by its author.

claims.text: On 8 March 2026, asked by Jesse Michels on the record whether he had confirmed writing the Wilson-Davis notes, Davis said: 'I can confirm. Seeking legal counsel. They're real. They're legit. They're 100% accurate.' He added that the circulated document is 'the typewritten version' and that 'there's a handwritten version, but that's all I can say about it.'
